title: Skills Hub Quick Run Configuration
description: Defines quick-run actions for a skill, shown in the Skills Hub tree view. Each action is either a chat prompt (sent to Copilot) or a terminal command (executed directly or via agent chat).

$schema.description: Reference to this schema file for editor auto-completion.

notes.description: Top-level notes shown at the top of the quick-run form, above all action sections. Use for environment requirements, prerequisites, or general warnings that apply to all actions.

actions.description: One or more quick-run actions exposed in the Skills Hub tree.

action.description: A single quick-run action. Must have either 'promptTemplate' (chat mode) or 'run' with 'command' (terminal mode).

id.description: Unique identifier for this action within the skill. Used internally — not shown to users. Example: "convert-single", "dry-run-validate".

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the quick-run form. Example: "Convert document to markdown".

description.description: Optional longer description shown as a tooltip or subtitle in the form.

promptTemplate.description: Chat-mode prompt template. Use {placeholders} for input values. Optional segments can be wrapped in [ ... ] and are included only when all placeholders inside are non-empty (example: "search wiki for {query} [in space {space}]"). Required when no 'run' block is present.

notes.description: Action-specific notes shown within this action's section, between description and input fields.

inputs.description: Input fields shown in the quick-run form. Each input's 'key' can be referenced as {key} in templates.

runConfig.description: Terminal execution configuration. When present, the action runs as a terminal command instead of a chat prompt.

type.description: Execution type. Currently only 'terminal' is supported.

command.description: The executable to run. Supports {placeholders} and optional [ ... ] segments. Use the built-in '{pythonExecutable}' for Python scripts.

argsTemplate.description: Command arguments as an array of strings. Each element supports {placeholders} and optional [ ... ] segments. Example: ["convert.py", "[--input {inputPath}]"].

cwd.description: Working directory for the command. Supports {placeholders} and optional [ ... ] segments. Defaults to '{skillPath}' if omitted.

input.description: A single input field in the quick-run form.

key.description: Unique key for this input. Referenced as {key} in templates. Example: "inputPath", "docType".

prompt.description: Label text shown next to the input field. Example: "Input file path", "Document type".

type.description: Input field type. 'text' = single-line text, 'multiline' = multi-line textarea, 'choice' = dropdown select, 'file'/'folder' = path with native picker, 'fileOrFolder' = path with picker that allows selecting either, 'path' = path with configurable picker.

required.description: Whether the user must fill in this field before running.

readonly.description: Whether the field is read-only (non-editable, browse button hidden for path inputs).

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown in the empty input field. Example: "C:\\work\\spec.docx".

default.description: Default value pre-filled in the input field.

choices.description: Options for 'choice' type inputs. Can be plain strings or {label, value} objects.

chooser.description: For 'path' type: what kind of native picker to show.

chooserMode.description: For 'path' type: whether the picker is for opening or saving.

multiple.description: Whether to allow selecting multiple files/folders (for 'file', 'folder', 'fileOrFolder', and 'path' types with a browse picker).

filters.description: File type filters for the native picker dialog. Keys are filter labels, values are arrays of extensions (without dots). Example: {"PDF Files": ["pdf"], "All Files": ["*"]}.

choiceObject.description: A choice entry with separate display label and submitted value.

value.description: Value submitted when this choice is selected.

noteObject.description: A styled note displayed in the quick-run form. Used for environment requirements, warnings, or tips.

type.description: Visual style of the note. 'info' = neutral/blue, 'warning' = yellow/amber, 'tip' = green/subtle.
